title: Admin Sidebar + Company Info Management — Phase 2 (versioning, history, expanded fields, tab shell)
description:
Phase-2 extension on top of shipped F1-F4. Source: full operator dispatch msg-go6tz9dxjj9g (full body). Phase-1 delivered against truncated brief (sidebar, AdminRouteGate, /admin/company-info CRUD-singleton, basic fields).

PHASE-2 NEW SCOPE (this top-level):

1. Expanded CompanyInfo schema/entity/migration
   - Add: companyName (separate from legalName), foundedYear (int), teamSize (int), industry, missionStatement (long text), visionStatement (long text), coreValues (string[] repeatable), certifications (string[] repeatable).
   - HQ location: already covered by addressLine1/city/country (review naming with spec section 'Headquarters location (address, city, country)').
   - Frontend form: section grouping (Legal & Registration / Identity / Key Facts / Contact), repeatable-list controls, validation parity client+server.

2. Backend versioning module
   - New Prisma model: company_info_versions (id, full snapshot JSON of all fields at save time, createdAt, editorUserId).
   - Every PUT /api/v1/company-info creates a new version row. 'Current' = latest version (timestamp desc).
   - New endpoints: GET /api/v1/company-info/versions (list, newest first), GET /api/v1/company-info/versions/:id (single).
   - Both admin-guarded (403 non-admin, 401 unauth).
   - Author attribution from auth user.

3. Admin internal tab shell
   - /admin route renders a layout with internal tab bar (currently routes to /admin landing + /admin/company-info as separate pages).
   - Company Info as default tab (active when route is /admin or /admin/company-info).
   - Layout structured for future tabs without refactor.
   - Route-based active state detection.

4. Frontend history view
   - 'View history' affordance on company-info tab.
   - History list view: timestamps + editor name, newest first.
   - Per-version read-only view, clear visual distinction from editable current.
   - Return-to-editable affordance.

OUT OF SCOPE:
   - Additional admin tabs beyond Company Info (extensible structure only).
   - User-management UI / role assignment.
   - Rollback/restore from past version (history is read-only).

Decomposition + chunks land via product-plan skill output to .overstory/specs/<this-id>.md.
